customManagers.description: Vendored protobuf pin in lib/VENDORED.txt. Renovate only flags the bump; run update_protobuf.py on the PR branch to swap lib/google.
addon_lastTestedNVDAVersion tracks the latest stable NVDA release.

packageRules.description: Vendored protobuf is refreshed by update_protobuf.py and must stay on 4.25.x: grpcio-tools 1.62.3 generates 4.25 gencode that 5.x rejects.
Python version is the NVDA runtime ABI (vendored cp313 wheels); bump only when NVDA changes Python.
wxPython is pinned to NVDA master's own pin so the GUI suite tests the wx the add-on runs against.
Raising the tested NVDA version is a compatibility claim: own PR, human review, e2e runs against stable NVDA.
